def apply(s):
    s = s.replace('z','xw')
    s = s.replace('e','ye')
    s = s.replace('b','h')
    s = s.replace('g','vzw')
    return s
inputs = ['xbu','uxwkkg','kib','fjze','cv']
outputs = [apply(s) for s in inputs]
print(outputs)
